title: Training Notes: Deducted Share of Remaining Units in Prior Authorization Extension Requests
content:
In a Prairie Ridge Prior Authorization extension request, the share of the units remaining on the authorization that is deducted follows the referrals the member's primary care provider issued, as recorded on the member's Primary Care Provider Assignment, in the six months before the day of the request.

## Rule

- Where a standing referral was issued in those six months, the share is **no halves** (0), so nothing is deducted.
- Where only a single referral was issued in those six months, the share is **one half** (1).
- Otherwise — no referral issued in those six months — the share is **two halves** (2), so all of the units remaining are deducted.

The deduction is the units remaining multiplied by the share's halves and divided by 2, rounded down to a whole unit. It is subtracted once from the units asked for, before the floor of zero is applied.

## Questions and answers

**The member's primary care provider issued both a standing referral and a single referral in the six months. What share applies?** A standing referral was issued, so the share is no halves and nothing is deducted.

**The only referral was issued seven months before the request. What share applies?** No referral falls in the six months before the day of the request, so the share is two halves and all of the units remaining are deducted.

**How is an odd number of remaining units halved?** The units remaining are multiplied by one and divided by two, and the result is rounded down.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

| Units remaining | Referrals in the six months | Halves | Deduction |
|---|---|---|---|
| 7 | a standing referral | 0 | 0 |
| 7 | a single referral only | 1 | seven divided by two is three and a half, rounded down to 3 |
| 7 | none | 2 | 7 |
| 4 | a single referral only | 1 | 2 |
